rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone opens their mouth wide, whether from yawning, anger, or surprise.

example.english: When they heard the news, they gape with their mouth wide open in shock.
example.traditional: 佢一聽到個消息，就張大個口，成個人呆咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 go3 siu1 sik1 zau6 zoeng1 daai6 go3 hau2 sing4 go3 jan4 ngoi4 zo2

rows.note: Use this when something such as a wound or crack has split open and leaves a visible gap.

example.english: The wall has a gape where it split open.
example.jyutping: dou6 coeng4 lit6 hoi1 zo2 jat1 tiu4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone stares fixedly at A in amazement or disbelief rather than merely opening their mouth.

example.english: We gape at him in disbelief, not knowing what he is talking about.
example.traditional: 我哋全部呆望住佢，唔知佢講緊乜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 ngoi4 mong6 zyu6 keoi5 m4 zi1 keoi5 gong2 gan2 mat1
